facts.fact: Dodai, an Addis Ababa e-mobility company, closed a USD 13 million Series A (USD 8 million equity, USD 5 million debt) from investors including British International Investment (UK), Value Chain Innovation Fund, IPC, Nagase, Persistent ACV Fund, For Seasons, CBC and ICJ (Dodai announcement, 2026-04-28).
